name: Lago di Sorapis (Sorapiss)
why: A milky turquoise lake under the Sorapis walls and the slender Dito di Dio, reached by a forest path that turns into ledges with steel cables.
book: Free. Roadside parking at Passo Tre Croci is small and full by 08:00 in summer: take the Dolomitibus/Cortina Express bus from Cortina or Misurina to Passo Tre Croci.
water: No reliable water on the way: carry 1.5 l. Rifugio Vandelli by the lake sells drinks and food.
dangers: Short exposed ledges with steel cables and metal steps above a drop: not for anyone with vertigo, keep children by the hand.
Wet rock on the ledges after rain is slippery.
Very crowded in July-August: queues at the cable sections.
turnaround: If the first cabled section feels too exposed, turn back there: the rest of the path is steeper and the last part harder.

points.name: Passo Tre Croci
points.note: 1,805 m, on the road between Cortina and Misurina. Path 215 starts a few hundred metres east of the pass and runs flat through the forest.

points.name: Cabled ledges on path 215
points.note: After about an hour the path is cut into the rock: steel cables and metal steps for some minutes, with a big drop on the left.

points.name: Rifugio Vandelli
points.note: 1,928 m, the hut 5 minutes before the lake: toilets, drinks and food.

points.name: Lago di Sorapis
points.note: 1,923 m, the turquoise lake with the Dito di Dio spire above it. Swimming is forbidden; walk the shore path for the best view.
